top.line: How the storm team's agents handed their roles to fresh sessions 106 times in 147.

in-short.line: A sentence, a pack, the real cost in memory, fresh sessions 53% to 84% cheaper per call.

count.para: Sessions end when they grow heavy.

pack.line: A briefing pack in five and a half minutes; a new agent started with 64% fewer tokens.

cost.line: The conductor's session: 327 million tokens, 99.4% re-reading.

start.line: The librarian retired itself at 03:02; six agents by 03:37; 72% less on the journalist's calls.

note.line: 21 hand-over files: what each role owns, its tools, what is next.

wrong.line: A shallow copy broke the record and was corrected in three minutes; keys passed sealed by the conductor.

why.line: Writing down what matters and starting again beats a session guessing what to keep.
why.para: How our writers hand over too.

limits.line: One-run pack test; measured savings on measured agents; the site's own count.

sources.line: The Storm Charles repository's count, journal and hand-over files.
